description: This Java source file contains unit tests for the class 'RequestResponseEndpoint' in the package 'org.eclipse.hono.service.amqp'. It employs Mockito and JUnit to verify behaviors related to AMQP messaging handling, link attachment, message processing, authorization, error handling, and subscription management within the 'Hono' framework. The tests focus on scenarios like message rejection, authorization failures, timeouts, malformed payloads, and subscription handling.

classes.name: RequestResponseEndpointTest
classes.description: Unit tests for the 'RequestResponseEndpoint' class, verifying AMQP link handling, message processing workflows, authorization scenarios, error handling, and subscription management.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes common mock objects and test fixtures before each test.

methods.name: testOnLinkAttachClosesReceiverUsingAtMostOnceQoS
methods.description: Verifies that a receiver with 'at-most-once' QoS is closed immediately upon link attachment.

methods.name: testOnLinkAttachOpensReceiver
methods.description: Verifies that a receiver with normal QoS is opened and assigned a handler when attached.

methods.name: testOnLinkAttachClosesSenderWithoutAppropriateReplyAddress
methods.description: Ensures that a sender lacking a suitable reply-to address is closed upon link attachment.

methods.name: testHandleMessageRejectsMalformedMessage
methods.description: Tests that malformed messages are rejected and the link is closed accordingly.

methods.name: testHandleMessageSendsResponseForUnauthorizedRequests
methods.description: Ensures that unauthorized requests result in a 403 response and do not proceed to service.

methods.name: testHandleMessageSendsResponseForTimedOutRequests
methods.description: Checks that timeouts lead to 503 responses sent back to clients.

methods.name: testHandleMessageSendsResponseForFailedRequests
methods.description: Verifies that internal failures trigger a 500 response.

methods.name: testHandleMessageSendsResponseWithStatusCode
methods.description: Helper method to test different error scenarios and expected HTTP status code responses.

methods.name: testHandleMessageSendsResponseForMalformedPayload
methods.description: Verifies that malformed request payloads trigger a 400 Bad Request response.

methods.name: testHandleMessageProcessesAuthorizedRequests
methods.description: Ensures authorized requests are processed and responses are forwarded.

methods.name: testDuplicateSubscription
methods.description: Tests that second subscriptions to the same address are rejected if first is active.

methods.name: testFreeSubscription
methods.description: Tests that a subscription is allowed after the prior connection is closed.

methods.name: hasStatusCode
methods.description: Checks whether a Message object contains the expected HTTP status code.

methods.name: getEndpoint
methods.description: Creates a test fixture instance of 'RequestResponseEndpoint' with customizable behavior for formal verification pass/failure.
